rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides programmatic access to the Groww trading platform API, enabling AI assistants to execute stock market operations including order placement, portfolio management, and market data retrieval. Built in Go with comprehensive tool coverage spanning order management (place, modify, cancel), account information (holdings, positions, margins), and live market data (quotes, LTP, OHLC, historical candles), it handles authentication via daily-expiring access tokens and includes automated release workflows with cross-platform binary distribution. Designed for traders and developers who need to automate Groww trading operations, it enables use cases like algorithmic trading, portfolio monitoring, market analysis, and automated order management without manual platform interaction.
